instruction: A clean studio portrait of two women against a solid dusty rose wall. On the left, the straight-haired woman in a denim jacket (R2) looks away in profile. Behind her, the curly-haired woman in a black tank top (R3) stands close, resting her hand with a silver watch on the other's shoulder while looking forward. Soft, diffused studio lighting illuminates the scene with a warm, minimalist aesthetic.
elements: R3 rests her hand on R2's shoulder rather than R2 resting a hand on R3
R3 stands close behind R2 while making the shoulder contact
R2 receives the shoulder touch from R3
R3's hand with a silver watch is the hand placed on R2's shoulder
the portrait is set against a solid dusty rose wall
